function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 平台 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 提供即時黃金、白銀等貴金屬價格、圖表與新聞 |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 金融市場資訊，含黃金現貨價格 |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 具備即時行情與分析 |
| **Investing.com** | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 提供多種貨幣計價的黃金價格與歷史走勢 |
| **Yahoo Finance** | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/ | 黃金期貨合約價格與相關新聞 |

您可以在這些網站上查看「Gold Spot Price」或「Gold Futures」的最新報價，通常會以美元/盎司（USD/oz）為單位顯示。若需要更精確的數字，請直接進入上述連結並確認「Spot」或「Live」欄位的價格。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources. We can also provide a typical price range. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites like Kitco, Bloomberg, etc.
